scaffold._discoveryPainPoints:
1. [TechnologyIntegrationFriction] NetSuite integration project delayed from 3 months to 9+ months with no resolution (intensity 9/10, stage: Product Fulfillment Lifecycle → Order Processing) ← flagged as binding
2. [TechnologyIntegrationFriction] 90+ Salesforce customizations making standard implementations difficult (intensity 8/10, stage: Territory Sales Execution → Customer Engagement) ← flagged as binding
3. [ProcessHandoffFriction] Sales team loses 3 days per week to admin and meetings instead of selling (intensity 8/10, stage: Territory Sales Execution → Customer Engagement)
4. [DataSignalFriction] Lack of pre-visit customer intelligence requiring manual information gathering (intensity 7/10, stage: Territory Sales Execution → Pre Visit Intelligence)
5. [IncentiveCapacityFriction] Distributors becoming order takers rather than proactive sellers (intensity 7/10, stage: Partner Distribution Management → Sales Enablement)
6. [GovernanceRiskFriction] Cannot enforce CRM usage due to system instability and user frustration (intensity 6/10, stage: Sales Performance Management → Activity Tracking)
